## Hypothesis

Porting the AGG_RECONCILE_FILL_APPENDED step from eod-flatten-aggressive.py to eod-flatten.py will ensure that both flatten jobs behave identically, thereby eliminating any discrepancies in trade recording between the two and ensuring no missing trades in the core EOD flattening. This is a data integrity change with no direct impact on strategy logic.

## Mechanism

The AGG_RECONCILE_FILL_APPENDED step in eod-flatten-aggressive.py scans the P&L statement for unrecorded fills and appends them to the trades record. By porting this exact step to the core eod-flatten.py, we ensure that the core flattening job also performs this reconciliation, thus making the two jobs identical in their trade recording behavior.
